title: Usage examples
responsibility: Shows documented examples as short titles and code with expected output comments.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.documentation
inputs.description: Documentation read from this entity at the selected commit; absent or invalid content shows a gap.

inputs.name: EntityExamples.setupTitle
inputs.description: Optional heading for setup shown once before documented calls.

outputs.name: EntityExamples
outputs.description: Only example titles and code snippets, or a stated gap when documentation is absent.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: An example containing BigInt cannot be serialized.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: The recursive formatter cannot render a circular example.

errors.name: Value access or conversion error
errors.description: A supplied getter, proxy or value conversion callback can throw while formatting an example.
